preview: An interview experience at Microsoft for an internship for Summer 2020, detailing the online round, online interview, and onsite interview rounds.
content: INTERVIEW EXPERIENCE - INTERNSHIP FOR SUMMER 2020 MICROSOFT [OFF CAMPUS] Yash S. Jain, B. Tech IT 2017-21 ONLINE ROUND [ONE TEST 2019] [90 mins] ● This round was open to students from all the Institutes across India. ● This round had 3 coding questions. ● Coding questions were very straightforward and were mostly implementation based with little logic required. ● One of the questions was ○ Given a JSON string find the max depth of the string. ○ Example “a:{b:{a:‘z’,b:‘y’},c:{z:[2,3]}}”. ■ Here the max depth is 3. ● I don’t remember the other 2 questions. ● I was able to solve and submit all 3 questions within 15 or 20 mins. ● After a month or so I got a call for Online Interview. ONLINE INTERVIEW [45 mins] ● This round focused on Data Structures, Algorithms and Implementation. ● Only one question was asked in this round. ● Problem: Implement a DS that supports 3 operations. ○ Insert ○ Delete ○ Get Random Element (Return a uniformly random element from the set of elements) ● It is guaranteed that the elements are unique. ● I was asked to implement DS that supports all these operations in O(1) time. ● After 15 mins or so I was able to come up with an optimal solution and was able to implement the same within 20 mins. ● After a week I received a mail for Onsite Interview. ● My Solution. ONSITE INTERVIEW ● The interview was at Hyderabad. ● Onsite Interview consisted of 2 Rounds. ● In my batch, there were 25 students out of which 9 got selected for the Internship. ROUND 1 [TECHNICAL] [60 - 75 mins] ● This round was majorly focused System Design but 2 DSA questions were also asked. ● Question 1 Given a matrix find a submatrix with the maximum sum. ○ The naive solution takes O(n ^ 4) time. ○ This is a standard DP question and can be solved in O(n ^ 3) time using 2D Kadane Algorithm. ○ I gave both solutions. ● Question 2 Given a row-wise and column-wise sorted matrix find a given element. ○ The naive solution takes O(n ^ 2) time. ○ Can be solved in O(n * lg n) time by applying binary search in every row or column. ○ Can also be solved in O(n) time by starting the search from the top right element. ○ I gave all 3 solutions. ● Both questions were asked in the first 15 minutes of the interview and the rest of the Interview was focused on System Design. ● Question 3 Design a Restaurant Management System. ROUND 2 [TECHNICAL + HR] [40 mins] ● During this round, Interviewer asked related to resume and my projects. ● Question 1 Tell me about yourself. ● Question 2 Given two very big numbers (each more than 500 digits), multiply them. ● Question 3 In one of my Internships I had created a website (along with one friend), So he asked me to explain my entire process of website development from requirement gathering till deployment. ● Similar questions were asked regarding my other projects. ● I have done Internship in my summer vacation of the second year at Samsung R&D Bangalore, So Interviewer asked me whether Samsung offered me an Internship this year and also asked me about my experience there. ● The Last Question Three Qualities why we should hire you? ○ It is a standard question and I gave the answer that I read online.
